Title: Page language not set
Why: The before pages have no lang attribute on <html> (capture pageData.lang is null). A real 3.1.1 failure, but the annotations don't list it.

Title: Targets smaller than 24x24 CSS px
Why: 2.5.8 is new in WCAG 2.2; the BAD annotations predate it. axe measures it directly.

Title: No landmark regions
Why: No main or other landmarks. A best-practice issue (not an A/AA failure); BAD predates landmark roles.
